observations: Indoor and outdoor units of a split system air conditioner are shown uninstalled on a tiled floor.
The word 'inverter' is printed on the front of the outdoor unit.
A brand logo is visible on both units but is too blurry to read clearly.
There is handwritten text in red marker on the outdoor unit.
The units appear used with some surface dust and dirt.
No remote control, piping, or mounting brackets are visible.

claims.evidence: The seller admits the fault and the units are shown disconnected and sitting on the floor in photo 0.
The text 'inverter' is visible on the outdoor unit in photo 0.

risks.proof: A technician's report or a video showing the unit powered on and displaying an error code.
A clear photo of the technical specification sticker (nameplate) on the side of either unit.

risks.risk: Missing remote control and installation brackets
risks.proof: A photo showing the remote and the metal wall-mounting plate.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification sticker (nameplate) on the side of the indoor or outdoor unit to confirm capacity and model.
Clear, close-up photo of the brand logo on the front of the units.
Photo of the remote control and any included installation accessories like the mounting bracket.
response.reason: The brand and cooling capacity (HP) are not legible in the photos. These details are essential to establish even a base scrap or repair value.
